prompt: Look at this video: my tiny dog barks (loudly) that huge dog!
explanation_ru: Для сравнения равных действий используется конструкция as + наречие + as: as loudly as.

prompt: With five broken lamps, the canal path isn't (safe) the main road.
explanation_ru: В отрицательном предложении для неравного сравнения используется not as/so + прилагательное + as.

prompt: Our old bread knife doesn't cut (cleanly) the green knife.
explanation_ru: После глагола cut нужно наречие в конструкции неравного сравнения: not as/so cleanly as.

prompt: Warning: thin wire bike locks are not (strong) steel U-locks.
explanation_ru: Отрицательное сравнение качеств двух предметов строится по схеме not as/so + прилагательное + as.

prompt: Declan says his new dishwasher is (twice / noisy) the old one.
explanation_ru: С кратными словами (twice, three times) в английском используется конструкция as + прилагательное + as, а не сравнительная степень с than.

prompt: After breakfast, the hotel pool doesn't have (many / free chairs) we need.
explanation_ru: С исчисляемым существительным во множественном числе (free chairs) используется конструкция as many + существительное + as.

prompt: Rohan says this soft cotton cloth is very ___ the roll from Jaipur.
explanation_ru: После прилагательного similar всегда ставится предлог to. Предлоги with, as или like — частая ошибка русскоязычных.

prompt: Chidi laughed because Tunde's green party shirt looked ___ his own shirt.
explanation_ru: С выражением the same используется союз as, а не like. Варианты equal with и similar as грамматически неверны.

prompt: Matej noticed both chemists sell these plasters at the same price like each other.
answer: Matej noticed both chemists sell these plasters at the same price as each other.
accepted_answers: Matej noticed both chemists sell these plasters at the same price as each other.
Matej noticed that both chemists sell these plasters at the same price as each other.
explanation_ru: После the same нужно ставить союз as, а не like (типичная калька с русского «такой же, как»).

prompt: Ethan's blue school jumper is just like Noah's jumper. → Ethan's blue school jumper is the same …
answer: Ethan's blue school jumper is the same as Noah's jumper.
accepted_answers: Ethan's blue school jumper is the same as Noah's jumper.
Ethan's blue school jumper is the same as Noah's.
explanation_ru: Конструкция the same as передаёт полное сходство вместо just like.

prompt: Did both mechanics fix a flat tyre (neatly) each other during their trial shifts at Freja's shop?
explanation_ru: В вопросе о равном качестве действия используется as + наречие + as: as neatly as.

prompt: Why do the lobby speakers shake our teacups (much) the band inside the main hall?
explanation_ru: Для сравнения степени действия с глаголом shake используется устойчивая связка as much as.

prompt: After this heavy update, older phone batteries don't last (half / long) they used to before lunch.
explanation_ru: Со словом half используется конструкция half as + наречие + as: half as long as.

prompt: My small violin case doesn't take up (half / much / space) that passenger's two huge bags.
explanation_ru: С неисчисляемым существительным space и словом half строится конструкция half as much + существительное + as.

prompt: On Tuesdays, the university canteen never cooks (many / hot meals) hungry students actually want.
explanation_ru: Исчисляемое существительное hot meals требует конструкции as many ... as (после отрицательного never допустимо и so many ... as).

prompt: I visited that famous cafe in Harrogate at the weekend, hoping for a cosy afternoon. Sadly, my pot of tea wasn't (hot) I expected, and the dry fruit cakes tasted completely (different) simple ones. Worst of all, the bill was (three times / high) our local cafe's prices.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске нужно отрицательное сравнение as/so hot as, во втором — предлог from (или to в британском английском) после different, а в третьем — кратное сравнение three times as high as.

prompt: Thierry: "Wait, Delphine, is your banana bread really (sweet) mine?" Delphine: "We followed totally different recipes at home. Still, your loaf rose (high) mine in the oven." Thierry: "How strange—your loaf is even (the same / size) mine."
explanation_ru: В вопросе и при равном действии используется as ... as (as sweet as, rose as high as), а для одинакового размера — the same size as.

prompt: Pieter and Lieve compared two small hotels along a quiet canal in Bruges. The yellow house charges (the same / rate) the green house next door, and both owners buy their morning cakes from one baker. Surprisingly, the smaller rooms upstairs feel just (comfortable) the big suites downstairs, and the breakfast room looks very (similar) a cosy family kitchen.
explanation_ru: Для одинаковой цены нужно the same rate as, для равенства качества — as comfortable as, а после similar всегда ставится предлог to.

prompt: Devon grinned as he played a dusty jazz record at the weekend fair. "Honestly, this bargain record plays (clearly) a brand-new copy from the shop," he told me. "The cover isn't (neat) the modern version, yet the shiny shop copy is (four times / expensive) this one."
explanation_ru: С глаголом plays используется наречие as clearly as, в отрицании — as/so neat as, а кратная разница в цене выражается через four times as expensive as.

prompt: Werner laughed because the second lost umbrella looked ___ the first one, right down to a scratched wooden handle.
explanation_ru: Правильное сочетание — (almost) the same as. Союзы than, like и so ... as здесь нарушают грамматическую норму.

prompt: Tariq explained to our group that modern clay water jugs in Luxor aren't very ___ the ancient pieces in the museum.
explanation_ru: После прилагательного different стандартно используется предлог from, а не like, as или with.

prompt: Natalie noted in her film review that the big-budget sequel wasn't as fresh than the first movie.
answer: Natalie noted in her film review that the big-budget sequel wasn't as fresh as the first movie.
accepted_answers: Natalie noted in her film review that the big-budget sequel wasn't as fresh as the first movie.
Natalie noted in her film review that the big-budget sequel wasn't so fresh as the first movie.
explanation_ru: Вторая часть конструкции as ... as — всегда союз as, а не than (ошибка возникает из-за смешения со сравнительной степенью).

prompt: Keisha sent me a photo of two pricey modern paintings in Chicago. Both canvases have blue stripes in the exact same places and identical wooden frames.
options: The second painting is twice as colourful as the first one.
The first painting looks completely different from the second one.
The two paintings look almost the same as each other.
Neither painting is as expensive as the wooden frames.
explanation_ru: По описанию обе картины почти неотличимы, поэтому подходит вариант с the same as each other.

prompt: Although we repaired all the wooden fence posts on our coastal pasture, fierce sea gales still knock them over (fast) we can hammer them straight.
explanation_ru: Для сравнения скорости двух действий используется наречие fast в конструкции as fast as.

prompt: I am emailing your customer service team because the new travel charger doesn't work (safely) my old one and gets burning hot within ten minutes.
explanation_ru: После глагола doesn't work требуется наречие в отрицательном сравнении: as/so safely as.

prompt: Arthur enjoys visiting the community theatre in Stratford-upon-Avon, though Saturday's play left him annoyed. During the tense final scene, the squeaky folding chairs creaked (often) the actors actually spoke. The hall certainly isn't (quiet) it should be for drama, and the distracted atmosphere felt totally (different) the calm evenings he used to love.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске сравнивается частота действий (as often as), во втором — отрицательное сравнение качества (as/so quiet as), а в третьем после different нужен предлог from (или to).

prompt: As a graphic designer in an open-plan Helsinki office, I spend most afternoons on video calls with clients. Since facilities moved the coffee grinder behind my desk, my corner is (noisy) a busy cafe, and I cannot focus (well) I could last month. Would you consider moving the machine to a corner that is (far) possible from our work desks?
explanation_ru: Конструкция as ... as употребляется здесь с прилагательным (as noisy as), с наречием после отрицания (as/so well as) и в устойчивом выражении as far as possible.

prompt: In a narrow Hanoi street, morning commuters gather around two rival rice stalls facing each other. Despite years of friendly rivalry, the soup on the left tastes remarkably (similar) the soup across the lane. Both owners serve steaming bowls (quickly) each other during the rush, and neither stall is ever (quiet) the new sandwich shop on the corner.
explanation_ru: После similar нужен предлог to, равная скорость работы передаётся через as quickly as, а после отрицательного neither используется as/so quiet as.

prompt: During our tour in Darmstadt, the guide explained that the twin weather satellites orbit at ___ above Earth while scanning opposite sides of the planet.
options: exact same height as each other
the same height as each other
the same height like each other
as high height as each other
explanation_ru: Слово same всегда требует определённого артикля the и союза as: the same height as each other.

prompt: Sergio warned the town planners that heavy sightseeing coaches are three times as heavy than the vehicles the old stone bridge was designed to carry.
answer: Sergio warned the town planners that heavy sightseeing coaches are three times as heavy as the vehicles the old stone bridge was designed to carry.
accepted_answers: Sergio warned the town planners that heavy sightseeing coaches are three times as heavy as the vehicles the old stone bridge was designed to carry.
explanation_ru: В кратной конструкции three times as heavy as второй союз должен быть as, а не than.

prompt: Rhys emailed the local council because the clubhouse showers in Cardiff are nowhere near as warm as they should be after a rainy rugby match.
answer: Rhys emailed the local council because the clubhouse showers in Cardiff are nowhere near as warm as they should be after a rainy rugby match.
accepted_answers: Rhys emailed the local council because the clubhouse showers in Cardiff are nowhere near as warm as they should be after a rainy rugby match.
explanation_ru: Предложение грамматически верно: усилитель nowhere near естественно сочетается с конструкцией as warm as.

prompt: At Nelson's Saturday market, the judges ended the bread contest in a tie because loaves from both bakeries tasted equally light and crisp, even though one shop charges far more.
options: The cheaper bakery's bread wasn't nearly as crisp as the expensive loaf.
The less expensive bakery's loaf proved just as light and crisp as its rival's.
Both bakeries charge the same price for bread that tastes completely different.
One bakery made twice as many loaves as the other, so the judges declared a tie.
explanation_ru: Ничья объясняется тем, что более дешёвый хлеб оказался таким же лёгким и хрустящим, как и у конкурента (just as light and crisp as).

prompt: Arjun and Meera noticed that the sugar water didn't look any different from the salt water until they tested both bowls in the freezer. → Arjun and Meera noticed that the sugar water looked the same …
answer: Arjun and Meera noticed that the sugar water looked the same as the salt water until they tested both bowls in the freezer.
accepted_answers: Arjun and Meera noticed that the sugar water looked the same as the salt water until they tested both bowls in the freezer.
explanation_ru: Отрицание отличий (didn't look any different from) перефразируется утвердительной конструкцией looked the same as.
